reply.emotion: welcoming and proud, showing someone your new home for the first time
notes: Used to mean an apartment or flat in a multi-story residential building.
Do not confuse with 'дом', which usually refers to a whole house or building rather than a single apartment.

senses.definition: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a larger building.

examples.text: Я купил новую квартиру в центре города.
examples.translation: I bought a new apartment in the city center.
examples.emotion: excited and proud to share good news about a purchase
